files.description: Alternative to gitDiff: changed files with their patch hunks, as returned by GitHub's pull request files API.

prUrl.description: Alternative to gitDiff: a public GitHub pull request, commit or compare URL (github.com/owner/repo/pull/123). Its .diff is downloaded; a diff over 300,000 characters is cut at a file boundary and the rest reported as unreviewed.
